messages:
Mara: Starting canary slice switchover for Kythera Dedicated — planned window 2026-07-12 03:00-04:00 UTC. Model pinned to redwood-large@v2.1. Need +ops and +release approval. Plan: enable slice-3 canary (10%), run smoke tests, gradual ramp, monitor errors/latency/evals, then decide go/no-go. Rollback criteria: 1) 5m sustained error rate >1% 2) p50 latency +200ms vs baseline 3) hallucination regression >3% on eval set. Please ack.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: rollout/kythera/1965432100. Preflight checklist attached. Run command: ```\nredwoodctl rollout canary --tenant kythera --model redwood-large:v2.1 --slice slice-3 --percent 10 --monitor 300\n``` Bot will post health ticks every 60s.

Sanjay: Confirm telemetry tag — will metric prefix be `kythera-2026-07-canary`? Also, can we freeze autoscale for that slice during the window? If autoscale kicks it may obscure latency/cost signals.

Leah: Yes to telemetry tag, I'll set `kythera-2026-07-canary`. Freezing autoscale for slice-3 during window, documented in the runbook.

Ben: Smoke tests that will run: `tests/smoke/kythera_basic.sh` and `tests/evals/kythera_regression.yml`. Expect ~3m to complete.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: infra OK, LB health OK, reserved GPUs available, no conflicting rollouts. Canary target: slice-3, capacity=12 GPUs. All checks passed.

Mara: Kicking canary at ts 1965432110. Starting at 10%.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary=10% -> slice-3. Timestamps: start=1965432110. Health ticks will follow.

Ops-Oncall: 1m update: errors=0.20% (user-telemetry), p50 latency delta +30ms vs baseline. No alerts.

Aria: Noting a small spike of 504s on internal tracer for provider-A on a subset of calls. User-facing telemetry doesn't show increased errors. Recommend hold at 10% until we see steady metrics for 15m.

Mara: Holding at 10% for 15m to observe. +Leah +Sanjay please confirm. If internal 504s persist but user errors stay low, we still may proceed.

Leah: :thumbsup: freezing autoscale + tracing enabled. I'll keep an eye on provider-A.

Sanjay: ACK. Telemetry tag confirmed. I'll gate the next ramp on the eval suite passing.

Devin: Running evals now against the canary: `scripts/run_eval --suite kythera_regression --tag kythera-2026-07-canary`. ETA 8m.

deploy-bot: Health tick @1965432170: errors=0.18%, p50 +45ms, 99th pct +120ms. No request error spike. Canary 10% steady.

Devin: Evals done: hallucination delta +1.1% (baseline->canary), quality metrics within acceptable thresholds. smoke tests passed.

Mara: After 18m observation metrics look stable (errors 0.18%, p50 +45ms, eval delta 1.1%). Proceeding to ramp to 30%.

deploy-bot: Ramping canary -> 30% at ts 1965432200. Command: `redwoodctl rollout scale --id rollout/kythera/1965432100 --percent 30`.

Ops-Oncall: Post-ramp check: errors=0.25%, p50 +60ms, no new 5xx spikes. LB healthy. No downstream errors reported.

Aria: Provider-A 504 rate returned to baseline after config tweak. Internal traces look clean now.

Mara: Good. We'll observe another 30m at 30% then decide full push. Current decision: PROCEED to monitoring phase. Marking provisional GO for wider rollout contingent on 30m stability. Final GO/NO-GO deferred to 1965434010.

Leah: Noted. I'll update the customer-facing release notes and pin the model version in the console.

Sanjay: I'll keep autoscale frozen until after final verification and rotate back afterwards.

Mara: Thanks team. If anything regresses, rollback plan: `redwoodctl rollback --rollout rollout/kythera/1965432100 --to-version redwood-large@v2.0` — exec within 5m. Otherwise leave this thread open for final sign-off.
